_readme: One flat array; the UI groups it as grade_subject_topic at load.
'subject' and 'topic' must match the Lab's own keys and topic strings
(LAB_TOPICS in index.html) so a video, its notes and its practice all
provider 'youtube' -> ref is the 11-character video id (embedded).
provider 'link'    -> ref is a full URL (opened in a new tab, not framed).
Add entries by hand, or use Add video in the study space.
